scope: All actual book-5 events plus Narak/Urithiru complete site records and Roshar/Braize parent metadata; parent gfx/map and other sites omitted, not certified

events.title: To the centre of the Plains
events.text: Dalinar marches on the Parshendi city as they summon a new storm from the west.

events.title: Urithiru found
events.text: Shallan opens the Oathgate and leads the armies to the lost tower city.

events.title: Kaladin’s Third Ideal
events.text: Kaladin swears to protect even those he hates, and flies.

events.title: Damnation named
events.text: The Heralds’ torment between Desolations is laid bare, and the Everstorm brings the return of something long imprisoned.

parent.name: Roshar

cognitive.name: Shadesmar
cognitive.blurb: Roshar’s subastral, the best known. Where Roshar has land there is an ocean of glass beads, each the soul of an object; where it has seas there is dark, obsidian-like ground. Spren live here openly, in cities such as Celebrant and the honorspren fortress of Lasting Integrity, and trade in Stormlight. People show as candle-like flames.

parent.status: Second planet · Shardworld of Honor, Cultivation and Odium
parent.distText: System drawn enlarged; planet order from the system chart
parent.blurb: A world of stone and wind scoured by highstorms that roll in from the east every few days. One supercontinent, also called Roshar, holds nearly all its life. Plants pull into the rock when the storm comes, animals carry shells, and spheres left out in a storm fill with Stormlight. The Alethi princes fight an endless war on the Shattered Plains, while old stories speak of Desolations and of the Knights Radiant.
parent.short: The storm world of the Stormlight Archive.

5.status: Second planet · Shardworld of Honor, Cultivation and Odium · the Everstorm

8.blurb: A world of stone and wind scoured by highstorms from the east, and now by the Everstorm blowing the other way. The Knights Radiant have returned, the singers have woken, and Odium’s Fused are back from Braize. Dalinar Kholin tries to hold a coalition of nations together through the True Desolation.

12.status: Retribution’s world · cut off in slowed time
12.blurb: Dalinar challenged Odium to a contest of champions and, holding Honor’s power at the end, renounced it. Odium took Honor’s power into his own and became Retribution, killed the Stormfather, drew all Stormlight from the world and turned the highstorm into a planet-wide Everstorm. Time on Roshar has slowed, so about a decade there passes for decades elsewhere. Only Azir is spared the storm.

parent.blurb: The third rocky planet, cold, barren and swept by wind under a thin atmosphere, probably outside the habitable zone. Rosharans call it Damnation. Its metallic core draws in souls and Investiture, which is why Odium, the Fused and the tormented Heralds were bound here between Desolations.

events.title: Rysn’s fall
events.text: Trading with the Reshi, Rysn climbs down a living island to plead with it. She falls, and the island gives her a live larkin.

events.title: The Battle of Vedenar
events.text: The succession war ends in a brutal siege of the capital. Its dying winner passes the crown of Jah Keved to Taravangian.

events.title: Four against one
events.text: Adolin duels for Shardblades to help his father, until a match becomes four Shardbearers against him and Kaladin jumps into the ring.

events.title: Lost in the chasms
events.text: On the march across the Plains, Kaladin and Shallan fall into the chasms and have to find their way out together, past a chasmfiend.

sites.name: Narak (Stormseat)
sites.desc: The old Natanatan capital at the centre of the Plains, the listeners’ stronghold, with an Oathgate on a plateau to its south-west.

landmarks.name: The listener city
landmarks.desc: Ruined Natanatan buildings at the heart of the Plains where the listeners make their stronghold. Here Eshonai’s people sing in the new forms that call the Everstorm.

landmarks.name: The Oathgate plateau
landmarks.desc: A round plateau south-west of Narak, its gate hidden under centuries of crem. Shallan finds the mechanism and carries the trapped armies away to Urithiru.

landmarks.name: Narak One
landmarks.desc: One of four fortresses Sigzil and Bridge Four build on Narak to hold the Plains through the ten days of the contest. It is the first to fall.

landmarks.name: Narak Two
landmarks.desc: The fortress Sigzil falls back to after Narak One is lost, and holds while Narak Three falls.

landmarks.name: Narak Three
landmarks.desc: The third fortress, lost on the seventh day.

landmarks.name: Narak Prime
landmarks.desc: The central stronghold and the last line on the Plains, stormed by Venli’s chasmfiends at the end of the defence.

sites.name: Urithiru
sites.desc: The ten-tiered tower city of the ancient Radiants, carved from a mountain high in the Mountains of Ur, home of the Sibling and hub of the ten Oathgates.

landmarks.name: The Oathgate platforms
landmarks.desc: Ten platforms on the plaza before the tower, each linked to an Oathgate across Roshar. Shallan’s gate from Narak brings the Alethi armies here at the end of Words of Radiance.

landmarks.name: The Gallery of Maps
landmarks.desc: A chamber near the top with a great map table, where Dalinar plans his coalition’s war.

landmarks.name: The Breakaway
landmarks.desc: The cavernous central market hall on the lower levels, where merchants and refugees fill the once-empty tower.

landmarks.name: The dark corridors
landmarks.desc: Miles of lightless, half-explored passages. Sadeas’s body is found in a corridor, and more killings follow.

landmarks.name: Re-Shephir’s chamber
landmarks.desc: A hidden ground-floor chamber where the Unmade Re-Shephir lurks. Shallan confronts her here with Lightweaving and drives her off.

landmarks.name: The gem archive
landmarks.desc: A room where the ancient Radiants stored their records inside gemstones.

landmarks.name: The crystal pillar
landmarks.desc: A pillar of gemstones deep in the tower, the heart of the Sibling. Raboniel pours Voidlight into it to seize the tower; Navani later bonds the Sibling here and becomes a Bondsmith.

landmarks.name: The Devotary of Mercy
landmarks.desc: A fourth-floor hospital for the wounded in mind, where Kaladin, retired from fighting, works with the patients.

landmarks.name: The cistern chamber
landmarks.desc: A water chamber in the tower where Dalinar opens a perpendicularity and goes with Navani into the Spiritual Realm.
